## Checklist

The full list is under "Commits and pull requests" in CONTRIBUTING.md at the
root of the repository. In short:

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (and `npm run e2e` if the web app or the export changed).
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests; changed golden PNGs were looked at.
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the issue that agreed to it is linked.
